title: Transform Vendor Invoice Processing With the Payables Agent in Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025)

chapters.title: Automatic invoice drafting and AI suggestions
Call to action and next steps

features.name: Payables agent
features.description: An AI-powered agent that automates vendor invoice processing end-to-end by automatically drafting purchase invoices, using AI and historical data to suggest vendor details, line types, dimensions, and deferral templates.
caveats: Requires manual review and confirmation before posting

features.name: Invoice data extraction
features.description: The payables agent extracts data from PDF invoices and presents it in a structured format for review.

features.name: AI-powered invoice suggestions
features.description: Uses AI and historical data to automatically suggest vendor information, invoice line types, dimensions, and deferral templates for vendor invoices.

features.name: Manual invoice review and confirmation
features.description: Users can review, accept, or adjust each agent suggestion before confirming the draft as a purchase invoice, maintaining full control over the process.
caveats: Manual confirmation required for all invoices

quotes.text: With the payables agent, the tedious task for handling vendor invoice processing end-to-end is soon a thing of the past.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core value proposition and scope of the payables agent feature.

quotes.text: the payables agent automatically drafts a purchase invoice and uses AI and historical data to suggest the vendor, invoice line types, and other information
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key technical capabilities and what the agent learns from historical data.

quotes.text: The payables agent doesn't post anything automatically and keeps us in control. We can review, accept, or adjust each suggestion before confirming.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies a critical limitation and design decision that users maintain final approval authority.

quotes.text: the agent supervisor can either send it for approval or proceed directly with posting it, depending on the setup.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows workflow flexibility based on organizational configuration for post-confirmation actions.

disclaimers.text: the tedious task for handling vendor invoice processing end-to-end is soon a thing of the past
